claims.label: Harpole Claims He Cut Charlie Kirk's Shirt Off at Hospital
claims.claim: Brian Harpole states in the Shawn Ryan interview that he personally cut Charlie Kirk's white "freedom shirt" off at the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Shawn Ryan show audio/video; cross-reference against hospital records, gurney handling logs, and ER staff testimony to verify or falsify Harpole's account.

claims.label: Sara Tewell's First Interview Asserted Shot to Heart
claims.claim: In her first Fox 13 interview, Sara Tewell stated that Charlie Kirk was shot directly in the heart from her right side, with a single shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Fox 13 footage; verify timestamp and quoted language against Sara Tewell's subsequent statements.

claims.label: Sara Tewell's Second Interview Asserted Shot to Neck
claims.claim: Approximately 51 minutes after her first interview, Sara Tewell stated in local media that Charlie Kirk was shot in the neck.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original local-media footage and timestamp; document any prompts or interviewer framing that may have influenced the revised account.

claims.label: Sara Tewell's ABC Interview Asserted Shooter at ~200 Yards
claims.claim: In her ABC News interview, Sara Tewell said she thought the shooter was about 200 yards away and that the shot struck Charlie Kirk in the neck, going "right into his left side."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 200-yard figure against the documented distance from the Losee Center to the courtyard; check ABC News raw footage for prior coaching or scripting cues.

claims.label: Host Says Judge Graf Denied Motion to Compel Lance Twiggs In-Person Testimony
claims.claim: The host says Judge Graf has denied the defense motion to compel Lance Twiggs to appear in person at the preliminary hearing set for the week of July 6.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying court order from Utah state court records to verify the ruling, its date, and its specific findings.

claims.label: Host Says Lance Twiggs Testimony Will Be Admitted as Recorded Statement
claims.claim: The host says that, under the judge's ruling, Lance Twiggs's testimony against Tyler Robinson will be presented at the preliminary hearing as a recorded statement rather than live testimony.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary-hearing scheduling order and any associated evidentiary rulings to confirm the recorded-statement procedure and the recorded-statement transcript.

claims.label: Viewer Email Suggests Enhancing SUV Shard Images for White Rode Mic Details
claims.claim: In a viewer email the host reads, the writer says some black shards in the SUV images appear to have white on them, notes that the Rode Wireless Go microphone has several white details, and suggests that enhancing the images could identify parts of the microphone body, while allowing that it "may be nothing."
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve viewer email as a tip lead; pursue forensic comparison of shard imagery with manufacturer specifications and any recovered physical shard fragments.

claims.label: Host Says Enhanced SUV Shard Images Show White Markings Matching Rode Mic Design
claims.claim: The host says the enhanced still images she displays show white markings on the SUV floorboard shards that visually align with the Rode Wireless Pro body design and labeling, as a viewer email she reads suggested.
claims.investigative_direction: Source original high-resolution images from Jon Bray or other collectors; submit for independent forensic image analysis.

claims.label: Host Says Rode Wireless Pro Destruction Video Produces Comparable Shard Pattern
claims.claim: The host says a YouTube video she plays, in which a third party destroys a Rode Wireless Pro, produces a shard pattern that visually resembles the shards on the SUV floorboard.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve the YouTube source video as comparison reference; identify original video uploader and timestamp; pursue additional independent destruction tests with documented methodology.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk's Signature Changed Dramatically Between Miss Arizona Era and Current
claims.claim: The host says the signatures she displays show Erika's current signature as visually distinct from her Miss Arizona era signature, a change she says people who knew Erika brought to her attention by email.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Miss Arizona-era signed documents from 2004-2007 competition records and notarized documents from current TPUSA / personal filings for forensic handwriting comparison.

claims.label: TPUSA moved to sell the "freedom shirt" for $59.99 after Charlie's death
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA moved to sell the "freedom shirt", like the one Charlie Kirk was wearing when he died, "like hotcakes right after he passed," at $59.99, and that she wanted to know what happened to the original.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive TPUSA's online store listing for the shirt to establish the date it went on sale, the price and whether it was described as a replica.
claims.transcript_snippet: the one that TPUSA moved to sell like hotcakes right after he passed. I don't Don't you want to own the shirt that Charlie Kirk was wearing when he died? $59.99 and it could be yours.

claims.label: Baron Coleman had already reported the answer on the shirt
claims.claim: The host says someone pointed out to her that Baron Coleman, in his early coverage of the case, had already furnished the answer to her question about what happened to Charlie's shirt.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Coleman's early posts or videos on the shirt and compare them with Harpole's later Shawn Ryan account.
claims.transcript_snippet: someone pointed out to me that Baron Coleman had already furnished the answer to it as well as other people a long time ago actually in his early days of covering the case.

claims.label: Soil was dug out and the site repaved within days
claims.claim: The host says 10 inches of soil were dug out immediately, the spot was repaved by Saturday (Charlie died on a Wednesday), and pavers were installed by Sunday, so the soil cannot be tested for explosive residue.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU facilities work orders and the paving contractor's invoices showing the dates of excavation and paver installation.
claims.transcript_snippet: they took care of that soil 10 inches of soil dug out immediately and repaved by Saturday. Charlie died on a Wednesday and that soil was gone by Saturday. By Sunday, pavers were installed.

claims.label: Necklace was sought by the feds and Frank Turek and then given to the widow
claims.claim: The host says the feds were looking for Charlie's necklace, as was Frank Turek, and that it was then given to the widow, who now wears it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who recovered the necklace, any evidence log entry for it, and the date it was released to Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: the feds were looking for it for some unknown reason, as was Frank Turek, and it was then given to the widow, who now wears it around her neck.

claims.label: Handheld microphone was not kept in evidence and went on display
claims.claim: The host says the handheld microphone was not kept in evidence because the widow needed it for the Mar-a-Lago fundraiser, where it is encased in glass beside her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI/Utah evidence inventory for the handheld microphone and photographs of the Mar-a-Lago display with the date of release.
claims.transcript_snippet: the widow needed that for the Mar-a-Lago fundraiser. It's encased in some glass, and she is mourning beside it with photographers at her helm.

claims.label: Host says she is being sued over the Harpole car-crash interview
claims.claim: The host says Brian Harpole joined Shawn Ryan for what she calls a "car crash interview," and that she is being sued over it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the complaint and identify which statements about the Shawn Ryan interview are at issue.
claims.transcript_snippet: according to Brian Harpole, who joined Shawn Ryan for a car crash interview, for which I'm being sued over.

claims.label: Harpole says he put Charlie on a gurney, gave patient information and cut the shirt for the defibrillator
claims.claim: In the Shawn Ryan clip, Harpole says he put Charlie on a gurney, wheeled him into a room, began giving patient information to the staff, and cut the shirt off so they could put a defibrillator on him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Timpanogos Hospital triage and ER records for the arrival, including who took patient information and when the shirt was removed.
claims.transcript_snippet: We put him on a gurney, and then I wheel him into a room. I start uh giving um uh the patient information uh to the staff there.

claims.label: Harpole says he discussed drugs and defibrillation with staff and then guarded the door
claims.claim: In the clip, Harpole says he went back and forth with staff on drugs and the defibrillator, then walked out and held guard on the outside door of the room so nobody else could come in.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview ER staff on duty about whether an unauthorized person directed care or guarded the door; obtain the hospital security log.
claims.transcript_snippet: stood outside uh the room and held guard on the outside door of the room so nobody else could come in there.

claims.label: The 911 call cannot be located and the caller is unidentified
claims.claim: The host says she still cannot work out who in the car called 911 and cannot find the 911 call, though it is said someone did call.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the dispatch record and audio for the Sept 10, 2025 911 call from Utah County dispatch.
claims.transcript_snippet: We still can't figure out who in the car called 911, and we can't find that 911 call, but they say someone did call 911.

claims.label: Harpole earlier said no CPR was done during the 8-minute ride
claims.claim: The host says Harpole previously said they did not do CPR during an 8-minute car ride, and argues this conflicts with his statement that he wanted to defibrillate at the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Harpole's earlier statements on CPR with the Shawn Ryan transcript and Frank Turek's own account of the ride.
claims.transcript_snippet: you told us that you didn't even do CPR. It was an 8-minute car ride. Now you're you're you want to defibrillate and bring his heart back online.

claims.label: Kash Patel took the cameras from inside the hospital
claims.claim: The host says Kash Patel "had to swoop in" and take the cameras from inside the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI evidence receipt or hospital correspondence showing what camera footage was collected, when, and on whose order.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's no wonder Kash Patel had to swoop in there and take the cameras from inside of the hospital.

claims.label: Per Harpole, Turek did not touch Charlie, yet Turek changed clothes at the hospital
claims.claim: The host says that according to Harpole, Frank Turek did not touch Charlie and just prayed in the back seat, but Turek notes he changed at the hospital and Mikey McCoy found him surgical scrubs because of blood.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Turek's own statement about changing clothes and the hospital's record of scrubs issued; ask what happened to the clothing he removed.
claims.transcript_snippet: According to Brian, he was just praying in the back seat. But for some reason, Frank notes that when he got to the hospital, he got changed.

claims.label: Host says she cannot find the shirt in evidence or court filings
claims.claim: The host says she does not see Charlie's shirt in evidence, marked as evidence, or in the court filings, and guesses it has been disposed of.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the State's exhibit and evidence lists in the Robinson case for clothing worn by Charlie Kirk, and the hospital's patient-belongings record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Cuz I don't see it in evidence. I don't see it marked as evidence. I haven't seen it in the court case filings that they have this shirt anywhere.

claims.label: The SUV was towed, cleaned and auctioned expeditiously
claims.claim: The host says, running the scenario that it was an inside job, that the SUV was sent for a tow, a cleanup and an auction very expeditiously and that they did not want to keep it for evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain tow, cleaning and auction records for the SUV with dates and the authority releasing it.
claims.transcript_snippet: The car was sent for a tow, a cleanup, and auction all very expeditiously. They didn't want to keep this for evidence.

claims.label: Jon Bray identified the mic as a possible shaped-charge source and looked for ABS shards
claims.claim: The host says Jon Bray immediately identified the mic as the potential source of a shaped-charge explosion and went looking for shattered ABS from the Rode Wireless Pro.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Bray's original posts and the source images he used, with dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Jon Bray, who immediately identified the mic as the potential source of a shaped charge explosion, was on the pursuit looking for shattered ABS glass from the Rode Wireless Pro.

claims.label: Host says she now believes the floorboard shards are Charlie's shattered Rode mic
claims.claim: The host says she can now state confidently that she believes the bits on the SUV floorboard are Charlie's shattered Rode mic, having earlier considered stepped-on sunglasses at low probability.
claims.investigative_direction: Commission independent forensic analysis of the shard images and, if accessible, the SUV interior.
claims.transcript_snippet: I can now state confidently that I believe the bits that were on the floorboard of the SUV are indeed Charlie's shattered Rode mic

claims.label: Host says the Rode wireless pair costs about $1,500
claims.claim: The host says it costs roughly $1,500 to purchase the Rode wireless microphones destroyed in the YouTube video.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Rode's list price for the Wireless Pro system and confirm which model Charlie wore.
claims.transcript_snippet: Assuming this guy is super rich cuz this is like $1,500 to purchase these things.

claims.label: Reviewer in the clip says the Rode Wireless Pro rear is glass
claims.claim: In the YouTube clip, the reviewer says it makes sense that the rear of the Rode Wireless Pro is glass, comparing it to the glass backing on iPhones for antennas.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Rode's teardown or specifications what material the unit's rear panel is made of.
claims.transcript_snippet: it kind of makes sense that this is glass because if you think about like iPhones, you know, they have that glass backing for antennas and such.

claims.label: Sara Tewell said the shot came during the question on transgenderism and gun violence
claims.claim: In her first interview, Sara Tewell says the second student was talking about transgenderism and gun violence when the shot happened.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the event video to establish the topic being discussed at the moment of the shot.
claims.transcript_snippet: the second student to get up was talking about transgenderism and how um gun violence has been very frequent with that community, and that is when it happened.

claims.label: Sara Tewell's two interviews were at about 1:17 p.m. and 2:08 p.m.
claims.claim: The host says the first interview was at 1:17 p.m. and the second about 50 minutes later at around 2:08 p.m., with the story changed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain broadcast metadata for both interviews to verify air times.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's what she said at 1:17 p. m. But then just 50 minutes later, she gives another interview, and her story has changed. This is given at around 2:08 p. m.

claims.label: Host Says Tewell's 200-Yard Estimate Matches the Distance to Losee Center
claims.claim: The host says Sara Tewell's ABC News estimate of how far away the shot was fired matches the distance to Losee Center.
claims.investigative_direction: Measure the distance from the courtyard seat to the Losee Center roof position and compare with Tool's figure.
claims.transcript_snippet: She's even able to confirm how many yards away the bullet was fired from, and it incredibly matches the distance to Losee Center.

claims.label: Bomb dogs were kept away from the scene
claims.claim: In her list supporting the exploding-mic theory, the host says bomb dogs were kept away from the scene.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU/Utah DPS incident logs showing whether and when K-9 units were called or deployed.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um bomb dogs being kept away from the scene. Why the crime scene was immediately paved over and the soil was excavated

claims.investigative_direction: Check discovery and the arrest booking record for any GSR kit or testing on Robinson's hands and clothing.
claims.transcript_snippet: why the feds did not conduct a standard gunshot residue test when Tyler Robinson was brought in.

claims.claim: The host says there is no available footage or eyewitness report of someone firing a shot from the Losee building, despite an active campus at midday.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the State's disclosed footage and witness list for any direct view of the roof position.
claims.transcript_snippet: why there is no available footage or any eyewitness reports of someone seen firing a shot from a Lozi building despite this being an active campus in the middle of the day

claims.label: Farnsworth violated the crime scene to remove the back footage
claims.claim: The host says Terryl Farnsworth violated the crime scene to remove the back footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original camera files, chain-of-custody records and police statements about Farnsworth's access to the scene.
claims.transcript_snippet: It explains why Teryl Farnsworth violated the crime scene to remove the back footage.

claims.label: No ambulance was on standby
claims.claim: The host says there was unusually no ambulance on standby at the event.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU's event safety plan and any medical-standby contract for the Sept 10 event.
claims.transcript_snippet: It explains why there was unusually no ambulance on standby.

claims.label: Erika was quick to forgive Tyler Robinson
claims.claim: The host says Erika was quick to forgive Tyler Robinson, which she says her theory explains.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original memorial-service remarks and compare them with later statements about the case.
claims.transcript_snippet: It explains why Erika was quick to forgive Tyler Robinson.

claims.claim: The host says the roommate Robinson may have been dating is the only source of "clear evidence" against him in the form of a dramatized text confession that she says does not pass the sniff test.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the charging documents and discovery showing the origin and metadata of the text messages.
